watches.name: Duneshore - Amaranth
watches.description: Our inaugural watch and a truly unique offering, the Duneshore is simultaneously refined and offbeat, lending itself to both business attire and casual environments. The watch features a mirror-polished “sand dunes” case, a double-curved exhibition caseback for maximum on-wrist comfort, pen-nib-inspired hour and minute hands, and an enamel-painted dial designed to give the impression of wet ink. This version comes in stainless steel with mauve dial and your choice of strap. NOTE: Straps marked with an (L) are from the 20mm Linden collection and have been adapted to fit the Duneshore with small, rubber spacers. These straps will come with a Linden buckle instead of the Duneshore buckle.

watches.name: Duneshore Shallows - Iron Jade
watches.description: As evidenced by its name, the Duneshore Shallows represents a different approach to the “dive watch.” We didn’t call our diver the Abyss Master or Ocean Lord or Kraken Blaster…no, we named this iteration of the Duneshore the “Shallows,” as the shallow seas are home to 90% of all marine species, as well as most recreational dives. The Shallows is a diver that’s capable (with 200M of water resistance), unashamedly casual, and in touch with the reality that - no matter the spec - a dive watch is more likely to be worn with short sleeves than it is with a wet suit. Why not embrace it?

watches.name: Linden - Amaranth
watches.description: The Linden is the second installment in our Calligraph family of watches, housing an enamel-painted “wet ink” dial and pen-nib-inspired handset in a 39 mm case that is 10.5 mm thick and 48.5 mm from lug to lug. The case is a 3-piece construction in 316L stainless steel with multiple chamfers, seven transitions between polished and brushed finishing, drilled lugs for easy strap changes, a sapphire display caseback, and a sapphire front crystal with underside anti-reflective coating. Inside the Linden is a Miyota 9015 with custom rotor and custom black date disk featuring lume-printed numerals. The Linden easily floats between dress attire and casual environments, with an almost confoundingly traditional appearance composed from multiple less-than-traditional elements. This version comes with a mauve dial and your choice of strap.
